cards.title: Pediatrician: Connection Matters More Than AI
cards.body: A pediatrician explains that loss of human connection poses the biggest threat to children's wellbeing, not technology itself. The solution involves spending more time talking openly with kids rather than restricting screen time.

cards.title: Toxic Relatives: Setting Boundaries for Kids
cards.body: Parents often struggle with how much contact to allow between their children and dysfunctional family members. This guide offers questions to help you decide where to draw the line.

cards.title: Why Kids Say 'Na-Na-Na' and Drive Us Crazy
cards.body: Readers explore why children's taunting behavior like the classic 'na-na-na-na' chant is so universally annoying to adults. Understanding this juvenile put-down helps parents respond more effectively.

cards.title: Music Lessons: Whose Dream Really Is It?
cards.body: Parents often push children toward music lessons based on their own regrets and desire for social admiration rather than the child's genuine interests. Understanding these motivations helps parents support their child's authentic path.

cards.title: Children's Data Stolen After Weak Password Security
cards.body: A company protecting children's data used 'Password1' to secure old accounts, leading to a ransomware attack that exposed sensitive information. The data watchdog reprimanded the organization for this negligent security breach.
